meta.name: healthcheck
meta.description: Host security hardening and risk-tolerance configuration for Bitterbot deployments. Use when a user asks for security audits, firewall/SSH/update hardening, risk posture, exposure review, Bitterbot cron scheduling for periodic checks, or version status checks on a machine running Bitterbot (laptop, workstation, Pi, VPS).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 加固主机安全并检查风险配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在运行Bitterbot的机器上做安全加固和风险检查。
copy.tagline_en: Harden host security and check risk configuration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to harden security and check risk posture on machines running Bitterbot.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查运行 Bitterbot 的主机安全，评估风险并给出加固方案。它会先收集系统信息，然后运行安全审计，最后根据你选的风险偏好生成修复计划。
howto.when: 当你询问安全审计、防火墙/SSH/更新加固、风险态势、暴露面检查，或要求对运行 Bitterbot 的机器进行版本状态检查时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下这台机器的安全状况。
我想加固我的 VPS，风险偏好选 VPS Hardened。
安排每周一次的安全审计。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will assess the security of the host running Bitterbot, evaluate risk, and provide a hardening plan. It first gathers system info, runs security audits, then generates a remediation plan based on your chosen risk tolerance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for security audits, firewall/SSH/update hardening, risk posture, exposure review, or version status checks on a machine running Bitterbot.

say_en.text: Check the security status of this machine.
I want to harden my VPS, choose VPS Hardened profile.
